The highly anticipated fourth season of "Ted Lasso" has officially come back (watch here), and Apple TV executive Eddy Cue recently hinted that the show has a bright outlook, with a long road ahead for the series.

Eddy Cue says "Ted Lasso" still has "plenty of stories" to continue

Apple has not yet officially confirmed "Ted Lasso" season 5, but various signs suggest that beyond the currently airing fourth season, there will be at least two more seasons.

Deadline reported last year that the cast has signed on for a three-season deal, corresponding to what is rumored to be a new three-season storyline envisioned by Jason Sudeikis.

With the show's return, Apple's head of services Eddy Cue was asked about the possibility of a fifth season and beyond.

In a ScreenRant red carpet interview, when asked about the possibility of "Ted Lasso" season 5, Cue said:

Although not quite an official confirmation of any specific plans, Cue essentially said that Apple is committed to continuing the story of "Lasso" for as long as possible.

The news is not entirely surprising, but it is still encouraging to hear. Hopefully it means the day of saying goodbye to these characters is still a long way off.

"Ted Lasso" season 4 premieres new episodes every Wednesday until October 7. The first two episodes are now available to stream on Apple TV.

Are you excited about the return of "Ted Lasso"? What are your thoughts on the new season? Feel free to share your views in the comments section.
